def VTask.evenOddRec {P : Nat → Sort u_1} (h0 : P 0) 
  (h_even : (n : Nat) → P n → P (2 * n)) 
  (h_odd : (n : Nat) → P n → P (2 * n + 1)) 
  (n : Nat) : P n :=
  match n with
  | 0 => h0
  | _ =>
    let k := n / 2
    if n % 2 == 0 then
      h_even k (VTask.evenOddRec h0 h_even h_odd k)
    else
      h_odd k (VTask.evenOddRec h0 h_even h_odd k)
